1. Engagement Scope

The scope of this engagement was to perform an independent audit of Barrister Consulting Group's automated employment decision tools for compliance with NYC Local Law 144. The assessment included a bias audit of 54 algorithms used in hiring and promotion decisions for roles based in New York City.

2. Methodology

A "look-back" analysis was performed on 54 terminated employee files from the past 24 months to assess compliance with state-specific final pay timing requirements and the proper handling of accrued vacation payouts.

4. Detailed Findings
HDR-7026-001MEDIUMMONITORING
Observation

EEO-1 Component 2 data submission contains statistically improbable values for 54 job categories

Corrective Action Required

The company shall engage a third-party firm to conduct an independent, privileged assessment of its corporate safety culture, focusing on leadership commitment, employee involvement, and hazard identification.

Management Response

The identified control weakness has been contained through the implementation of a temporary manual workaround. A permanent, automated control is in development with a target implementation date of Q4 2016.

Owner: Benefits Specialist • Due: 2014-10-28
HDR-8380-002LOWMONITORING
Observation

USERRA reemployment rights not properly communicated to 54 employees on military leave

Corrective Action Required

Automate the COBRA notification process to ensure qualifying event notices are generated and mailed within 5 business days of the triggering event.

Management Response

The finding is valid. We have engaged our external auditors to perform an independent review and provide recommendations for a permanent solution. Their report is expected within 54 days.

Owner: Senior Analyst, Corporate Strategy • Due: 2014-11-28
HDR-6891-003LOWDEFERRED
Observation

401(k) plan fiduciary committee has not met in 54 quarters, violating its charter

Corrective Action Required

The company will engage an independent auditor to conduct a bias audit of its automated hiring tools before the statutory deadline for NYC Local Law 144.

Management Response

Management accepts the finding. The relevant system configuration has been updated, and the change will be deployed to production during the next scheduled release on 2014-07-27.

Owner: Vice President of Business Development • Due: 2014-08-28
HDR-9962-004MEDIUMMONITORING
Observation

Automated employment decision tool bias audit not conducted as required by NYC Local Law 144

Corrective Action Required

All nonqualified deferred compensation plan documents shall be amended to conform with the distribution and election timing rules under IRC §409A, effective the next plan year.

Management Response

The finding is valid. A budget of $54K has been approved to procure the necessary technology to automate this control. Implementation is projected to take 45 weeks.

Owner: Manager of Government Relations • Due: 2014-09-28
HDR-4800-005LOWREMEDIATED
Observation

Reasonable accommodation for religious practices not documented for 54 employee requests

Corrective Action Required

Barrister Consulting Group shall conduct a full pay equity analysis across all protected class segments within 45 days of report issuance and submit a remediation plan to ACPWB for review.

Management Response

Management concurs with the finding and has already initiated corrective action independent of this review. The designated owner will provide written confirmation of full remediation no later than the due date specified above.

Owner: Senior Analyst, Market Intelligence • Due: 2014-09-28
HDR-9236-006HIGHOPEN
Observation

401(k) plan loan administration not in compliance with plan document provisions for 54 participants

Corrective Action Required

Barrister Consulting Group shall conduct a full pay equity analysis across all protected class segments within 45 days of report issuance and submit a remediation plan to ACPWB for review.

Management Response

Management acknowledges the finding and has initiated a preliminary review. The designated owner will oversee remediation. Barrister Consulting Group requests a 30-day extension to the original due date to allow for thorough analysis across all affected locations.

Owner: Associate, Talent Acquisition • Due: 2014-10-28
HDR-8551-007LOWIN PROGRESS
Observation

Overtime eligibility misclassification affecting 54 employees in applicable job families

Corrective Action Required

The designated management official at each of the 11 establishments shall personally certify the OSHA 300A summary by the February 1st deadline annually.

Management Response

We concur. A project charter has been approved to address this finding. The project manager has been assigned, and a kickoff meeting is scheduled for 2014-07-27.

Owner: Director of Brand Marketing • Due: 2014-10-28
